recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-24862 intent on the current Consent model without reopening the already-decided FHIR-45450 URI element work or the separate FHIR-31568 example cleanup audit.
issue_request: FHIR-24862 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent and requested adding Consent.policy.uri to the Consent search parameters, with guidance that the URI should be versioned and/or dated because the URI element itself does not necessarily carry separate version metadata.
initial_application: Commit e8cfbf5b5db69f3876c3bee18cbb0a484a12118c initially added Consent-policy-uri for the then-current Consent.policy.uri path. Later Consent model changes made that path orphaned; commit 6c429ba35c61fd2dd5a24c2c9eb90b848b133d05 commented out the failing search parameter, and commit 3d15d8f10db9fb3f2f57469a3fa986e3baebc1f0 removed it while refactoring the policy structure.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini and source/consent/bundle-Consent-search-params.xml is the active current search-parameter bundle. FHIR-45450 later restored the current policy identifier child as Consent.policyBasis.uri with datatype uri, and a previous reconciliation commit already aligned the parent definition with URI wording. FHIR-31568 is related background because it tracked Consent search-parameter example coverage, including policy-uri historically, but it is already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Added active Consent-policy-uri with code policy-uri, type uri, and expression Consent.policyBasis.uri. Added a dated policyBasis.uri value to consent-example-OrgToOrg.xml so the restored active search parameter has current example coverage.
source_changes: source/consent/bundle-Consent-search-params.xml: added active SearchParameter Consent-policy-uri with expression Consent.policyBasis.uri and version/date guidance.
source/consent/consent-example-OrgToOrg.xml: added a dated policyBasis.uri example value.
